## What changed

Describe the observable change and why it belongs in Post Type Switcher.

## Risk and compatibility

- [ ] Public methods, hooks, filters, request fields, metadata keys, and script handles remain compatible.
- [ ] PHP 8.0 and WordPress 6.2 compatibility are preserved.
- [ ] Classic Editor, Block Editor, Quick Edit, Bulk Edit, and WPML impact is described.
- [ ] Capability, nonce, dependency, generated-asset, automation, and release implications are identified.

## Validation

- [ ] Regression coverage was added or the reason it is unnecessary is stated.
- [ ] `composer test` passes.
- [ ] `composer phpstan` passes.
- [ ] `npm run build:check` passes.
- [ ] The production artifact contains no development files.
